findings.title: PosCashDrawerSessionDialog active-view shows 'Mouvements 0 / Attendu 50.00€' until cashier clicks 'Voir les mouvements'
findings.evidence: movementsCount returns this.movements.length which is empty until $store.dispatch('cashDrawer/loadMovements') is called by openMovements(). On first dialog open in 'active' mode, expectedTotal computes (opening + []) = opening only.
findings.impact: Cashier opening drawer dialog at end of shift sees WRONG expected total until they manually click 'Voir les mouvements' — risk of premature close with wildly negative variance, false 'forgot to record cash' panic.
findings.suggested_fix: Call cashDrawer/loadMovements() inside resolveMode() when mode='active' (or on dialog mount).

findings.title: Raw i18n key 'label.notes' rendered as column header in Mouvements de caisse modal
findings.evidence: DOM table header reads literally 'label.notes' instead of resolved FR translation 'Notes'
findings.impact: User-facing visual defect; CLAUDE.md §6 raw label red-flag.
findings.suggested_fix: Use $t('label.cash_session_movement_notes') or add 'label.notes' key to lang/fr/label.php.

findings.title: Vue Caisse Unifiée 'Espèces encaissées aujourd'hui' DOES NOT MATCH cash_movements ledger sum
findings.evidence: UI shows 46.00€ (6 transactions rows in transactions table today) — actual cash_movements for same day sum to 105.70€ (7 rows for session_id=1). 5 cash_movements rows [4,5,6,7] for orders 79,81,82,84,85 have NO matching transactions entry, so the cash-overview accounting is short by 59.70€.
findings.impact: If admin reconciles by Vue Caisse Unifiée's 'Espèces attendues au tiroir' (96€) while the dialog's reconcile uses cash_movements (155.70€), they will produce a -59.70€ variance reason needed. Cross-surface number disagreement = bad UX + risk of false fraud alert.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) backfill transactions table on every cash payment to keep both ledgers in sync, OR (b) make CashOverviewController.drawerCashCollectedUnfiltered() pull from cash_movements (authoritative for drawer reconcile) instead of transactions. Recommend (b) — cash_movements is the SSOT for drawer state.

findings.title: Variance threshold = 2.00€ (config('cash.variance_threshold_eur'))
findings.impact: Any |variance|>2.00€ requires variance_reason+permission cash.reconcile.variance.override. Within tolerance (e.g. 155.70 expected vs 154.00 counted = -1.70€) closes cleanly.

findings.title: Suspicious variance (>20€) NOT auto-escalated beyond manager permission
findings.evidence: Only ONE threshold (2€). A -50€ écart with reason='theft suspected' + admin permission would reconcile without further escalation. No notification to upper management, no quarantine state, no automatic audit-log alert beyond the standard cash.session.reconciled HMAC entry.
findings.impact: V1 acceptable (single-cashier Le Cayenne LOCAL). V2 SaaS multi-branch would benefit from second-tier threshold (e.g. >20€ -> branch_manager + auto-email regional).

findings.title: Loyalty redemption does NOT write to NF525 audit_logs HMAC chain
findings.evidence: audit_logs count BEFORE redeem = 19, AFTER redeem = 19 unchanged. Only Log::info(channel='[Loyalty] POS redeem applied') line 234-242 + loyalty_transactions row.
findings.impact: A successful loyalty redemption modifies order.discount + order.total (post-create NF525-relevant changes) but is NOT entered in the tamper-evident HMAC chain. Forensic reconstruction relies on loyalty_transactions (which has its own append-only design + UNIQUE constraint) — acceptable for V1 single-resto, but LOCK_POS_LOYALTY_REDEEM_UI §6.5 wording 'audit log' is ambiguous and arguably misleading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add CashDrawerService::writeAuditLog equivalent for 'pos.loyalty.redeemed' so the change to order.total is traceable in the HMAC chain alongside cash.session.* events.
